violated_contract: A webhook that correlates a provider callback to our own record by the provider's job id must reject a callback that carries no usable id before it queries. The Firestore client encodes `field == None` as an IS_NULL filter instead of refusing it, so an absent id silently matches every record still waiting for its provider id -- rows created before the provider job started, or whose submission failed -- and the unauthenticated payload then drives that unrelated record's status and stored results.
canonical_prevention: Validate the correlation id at the route (a non-blank string) and answer 4xx before any lookup; never pass an optional id into an equality filter. A hermetic route test posts the id missing, null, empty, blank and non-string, and asserts a 400 and that the processing function is never called.
